query: SK Hynix Q2 2026 earnings release date confirmed - when will SK Hynix report second quarter 2026 results? Check Investor Relations calendar and DART filings for July 2026 date.
answer:
## Summary

**SK Hynix will report its Q2 2026 results on July 29, 2026, at 9:00 a.m. Seoul Time (KST).**

This is confirmed by the **primary source** — SK Hynix's own **SEC Form 6-K filing, signed July 15, 2026** by its Head of Investor Relations. The filing states the company will hold a conference call "to discuss its 2026 second-quarter earnings results," with results released the same day and webcasts (Korean + English) available via the IR website.

**Key notes:**
- ✅ **Confirmed date: July 29, 2026** (primary company/SEC disclosure)
- ⚠️ One aggregator (stockinvest.us) listed an unofficial **estimate of July 22** — this is superseded by the confirmed filing
- The equivalent filing also appears on Korea's DART system; the SEC 6-K is its English-language counterpart
- Consistent with SK Hynix's historical late-July Q2 cadence and its Q1 2026 release on April 22, 2026
